title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ContainerImage
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ContainerImage. Image available for containers. Subclass of Image per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Image model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ContainerImage'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

baseContainerImage.description: Relationship. Container image base software stack. Links to a BaseContainerImage entity.

containerFormat.description: Property. Container image format. Controlled-vocabulary value (ContainerFormat), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
